One-week event (each game takes 2–15 min, with cooldowns from 15 min to 20 h)

Orcsoberfest is a seasonal event on {wiki:Orcsoberfest Island|Orcsoberfest Island}, where the brutish {creature:Orger|Orgers} organise "games" that are just excuses to eat and drink. You take part in fishing, hammers, races, sausage contests and King Chuck's banquet to earn {wiki:Festive Point|Festive Points}, which you trade with {npc:Xaver} for rewards. Each edition you take part in also gives you a piece of the Traditional Set and, every two, a part of the Orcsoberfest Garb outfit.
The "games" in which the brutish Orgers take part are thinly disguised excuses to stuff their bellies, while they take the chance to torment the orcs that serve them.
Tent south of Thais (trip to Orcsoberfest Island)
The event runs from the **second Friday to the third Friday of October and March** (plus the following rewards weekend).

Most games only have a cooldown: go from game to game to collect points faster.
Make friends on the island: the Sausage Eating Contest needs 3 players, the Feast is much easier with 3–5 and the race gives everyone more points when there are more winners.
Win each game at least once to get the **Orcsoberfest Welcome** achievement.
During the event, go to the tent that appears **south of Thais** (leave Thais by the south exit) and enter the teleport inside: you are taken to {wiki:Orcsoberfest Island|Orcsoberfest Island}.
Teleport in the tent south of Thais
To leave the island whenever you want, go back to where you arrived and do the reverse route to the tent south of Thais.

{npc:Xaver} is on the island. You buy {item:Worm|Worms} from him (say {key:hi} and {key:worms}), as well as the {item:All Knowing Sausages} (100 Festive Points), and you exchange your Festive Points with him for the rewards.

Climb to the top of the mountain, **east** of the Smugglers' house, using stacked {item:Parcel|parcels} or the {spell:Levitate} spell. Open the {wiki:Frozen Chest|Frozen Chest} and you receive a {item:Rum Flask} with {item:Rum}. To come back down, go back the same way you went up (with {spell:Levitate}, use *exani hur down* facing the lower side).

Buy several {item:Worm|Worms} from {npc:Xaver} ({key:worms}). Go **west** of the island's boat, where there are several fishing rods by the sea. Each rod gets a white cloth for **15 seconds** after being used and cannot be used again during that time. **Prize: 10 Festive Points.**

Use the {item:Simple Fishing Rod|Simple Fishing Rods} (each attempt uses up a Worm) until you catch a {item:Tiny Bass}. Success message: *"A bass bites! [...] Finally he gets weary - a good catch!"*. Success rate: about 33%.
Fishing a Tiny Bass and a Small Bass
With the {item:Tiny Bass} in your inventory, use the {item:Stout Fishing Rod|Stout Fishing Rods} until you catch a {item:Small Bass}.
Finally use the {item:Advanced Fishing Rod|Advanced Fishing Rods} until you catch a {item:Bass} (*"A large one! [...] Finally you reel in your catch of the day!"*). Success rate: about 10%.
Most attempts fail: the best approach is to keep moving along the coast, using the free rods, until you complete the three stages.

Use the {item:Super Cask|Super Casks} scattered around the games area. You get {wiki:Drunk|drunk} and, if you drink several in a row, you become **Superdrunk**. It can be done **once every 30 minutes**. **Prize: 15 Festive Points.**
The Superdrunk effect lasts only a few seconds. Use the Super Cask next to the Nailing Beam north of the Porker.

Still Superdrunk, use one of the {item:Nailing Beam|Nailing Beams}. The best one is the one just **north of the Porker**, because it is hard to walk while drunk. You can use the beam **3 times**, 5 points each time; after the third the 30-minute cooldown starts.
It is much easier with a friend: they push your character to the beam, and being pushed does not make you stumble.

In the centre of the games area there is a large fenced rectangular area. To the **south** of it is a teleport to the platform with the lever. It is a **solo** game, **once every 15 minutes**. Before you go in, leave an empty action button ready for the hammer.

Pull the lever, immediately pick up the {item:Orc Hammer} in front of you and drag it to the action button. The window is set to **Equip/unequip**: change it to **Use with crosshairs**. Use the hammer on the orc heads that pop up on the {item:Armable Beer Trap (Empty)|Armable Beer Traps}.
**Do not hit the cats**, or you are disqualified.
Speed Set and speed spells help, because sometimes the heads appear a few sqm away from you. It is normal not to reach 15 on your first attempt.

It is **northeast** of the games area. You need **3 to 5 players**; it can be done **once every 15 minutes**. Pull the lever together: each of you goes to a table with {item:Competition Sausage|Competition Sausages}. Use the plate to eat the sausage; after a few seconds another appears. Whoever eats all the sausages in the **5 rounds** wins.
Go hungry. Each sausage adds a different amount of time to your food timer: if you get full before the end, you lose.

The entrance to the race tracks is **north** of the games area. You can go alone or with up to 3 players, **once every 30 minutes**. You have to take the {wiki:Food Wagon|Food Wagon} to the other side in under **1 minute 30 seconds**. The wagon follows you, so you have to go ahead. **Prize: 15 to 45 Festive Points** (the more winners, the more points for everyone, even those who failed).

Always keep the wagon on the **grey Cobblestone** and avoid sand and tar. Keep it away from {creature:Slowing Slime|Slowing Slimes} and, above all, from {creature:Annoying Dog|Annoying Dogs} (one appears shortly after the start and another halfway): both slow the wagon down.
More speed — use it whenever you can
Area attack that slows the wagon down a lot
Follows you and slows the wagon down: do not let it get near the wagon
Used on the wagon: drops meat (the dog becomes an {creature:Eating Dog} and slows down) or removes the wagon's paralysis
Area attack that removes the wagon's paralysis
The dog right after being distracted by the meat. Walk on the grey cobblestone as much as possible
The race with the Food Wagon

The best use of the {item:Orger Fork} is to remove the wagon's paralysis. If you do not pick up the fork at the start, you avoid the first dog completely; if you do pick it up, use it on the wagon straight away at the start to deal with the first dog.
Cave under the island, with a teleport just **north** of the island's dock. To enter you need 10 *Schnitzel Points*.
The Great Schnitzel Hunt — finding the gate

The Great Schnitzel gate appears near one of 17 cities and **changes place every 2 hours**. To find it, buy the {item:All Knowing Sausages} from {npc:Xaver} (100 Festive Points; they are not used up) and use them. Travel to the indicated city (the gate may be near Thais, Venore, Kazordoon, Port Hope, Liberty Bay, Svargrond, Yalahar, Issavi, Rathleton and others) and look for the {item:Omnious Cauldron} near it. The cauldron takes you to the Great Schnitzel's lair, which is under Orcsoberfest Island.

At the gate, step on the {item:Omnious Cauldron} to enter the lair. The creatures inside **do no damage**. Kill the {creature:Spawn of the Schnitzel|Spawns of the Schnitzel}, pick up the {item:Schnitzel Meat Grinder|Schnitzel Meat Grinders} they drop and use them on {creature:The Great Schnitzel}. Each Meat Grinder used gives **1 Schnitzel Point** (maximum 50 accumulated).
The Meat Grinders disappear 10 minutes after the Spawn appears: do not hoard them. That is also why it is normal for the first Spawns to come empty-handed.

Use the teleport just **north of the island's dock**. Entering costs **10 Schnitzel Points** and gives you free access for **2 hours**: during that time you can come and go through the same teleport as you like, without spending more points.
Inside there are {creature:Orger|Orgers}, {creature:Bellicose Orger|Bellicose Orgers} and {creature:Loricate Orger|Loricate Orgers}.
The {creature:Orger|Orgers} leave {item:Vomit Puddle|Vomit Puddles}. Use a {item:Broom} on a puddle to earn **1 Festive Point**. Once every 15 minutes.
Do not Feed the Porker — gather food

The game is in the centre of the games area, in the small pigsty. All participants together have to give **300 items** to the {creature:Meager Porker}. The items are dropped by the {creature:Orger|Orgers} in the Feeding Grounds and disappear shortly after being picked up, so you can only carry about 5–10 at a time and have to make several trips.
Leave the Orgers on low health (they run away from players) and corner them in a corner of the cave's first floor: they will drop lots of items in the same spot.
Do not Feed the Porker — kill the Fat Porker

When the pig gets fat, it turns into the {creature:Fat Porker}, a creature with lots of health but harmless. Kill it. Whoever wants to win must have fed the pig **and** attacked the creature. Points depend on how much food you gave.

In the Feeding Grounds, go down to the **second floor** and look for the teleport on the **west** side of the cave. 1 to 5 players can enter (at least 3 recommended). You can do the Feast **once per hour, up to 3 times in 20 hours** (the 20 hours count from the last attempt of the day). You have **10 minutes** for all phases.

The {wiki:Orc Cook|Orc Cook}, southwest of the room, shouts which ingredient (or firewood) the king wants in the cauldron in the centre. The ingredients are on 4 tables, one on each side of the room. Use the right table to pick up the ingredient and use it in the cauldron straight away. If you fail in time, the team loses time.
Where each ingredient is on the tables
Using the right ingredient on the cauldron
Put one player in charge of each table. The ingredients are not normal items: you can't bring them from outside.

After 5 ingredients in the cauldron, 4 {creature:Rampaging Beer Elemental|Rampaging Beer Elementals} appear. Lure them onto the traps on the floor: they become {creature:Captured Beer}. The Captured Beers run away from you: push them (by walking behind them) to the other barrels in the **northwest** of the room.
The Rampaging Beer Elementals in the Feast room
Don't let the Beer Elementals hit you: every 3 hits you lose 1 minute of the maximum time.

After you have done the first two phases twice, {wiki:King Chuck|King Chuck} gets up from the table as {creature:Angry King Chuck}. Use the barrel near the Orc Cook (southwest): a barrel of {wiki:Strong Orger Beer|Strong Orger Beer} appears near the cauldron. Lure the king to the barrel so he drinks. After **5 barrels** he calms down and goes back to the table.
Use the barrel near the Orc Cook
Lure King Chuck to the Orger Beer
Don't let Angry King Chuck hit you: after a few hits (about 3) you are kicked out of the room.

After you have calmed the king twice, an {wiki:Orger Treasure|Orger Treasure} appears **south** of the cauldron. It has lots of health but doesn't attack. Destroy it with everything you have (the remaining time may be short) to get the loot.
100 Festive Points and a small chance of an Orcsoberfest plushie
Exchange the {wiki:Festive Point|Festive Points} with {npc:Xaver} on the island for various rewards. Win all the games at least once to get the **Orcsoberfest Welcome** achievement.

In each edition of the event in which you defeat {wiki:King Chuck|King Chuck} you receive a piece of the {wiki:Traditional Set|Traditional Set}; every two participations you also receive a part of the outfit. At least 6 editions (3 years) are needed for the full outfit.
On the weekend after the event (from Friday's server save to Monday's server save), all worlds receive **50% extra XP** against creatures of the Demon class in the Bestiary.
The event repeats twice a year (October and March); pieces and addons carry over between editions.
Approximate fishing rates: 33% with the Simple Fishing Rod, 10% with the Advanced Fishing Rod.
